codeReview.summary: The feature establishes broad DB package scaffolding, migration wiring, and tests, but the schema/migration foundation is not yet reliable enough for downstream repository work because several declared relations are not backed by foreign-key constraints in the actual tables, and the current tests do not catch those integrity gaps.

issues.description: Several ID fields that represent entity relationships are declared as plain text columns instead of foreign keys (for example `workflow_tasks.parent_task_id`, `workflow_tasks.active_checkpoint_id`, `workflow_packs.current_step_id`, `normalized_nodes.parent_node_id`, `evidence_fragments.normalized_node_id`, `evidence_fragments.task_id`, `claims.normalized_node_id`, `zotero_mappings.normalized_node_id`, `zotero_mappings.source_id`, `compliance_issues.normalized_node_id`, `academic_qa_issues.claim_id`, `academic_qa_issues.normalized_node_id`, and `build_runs.checkpoint_id`). Downstream features depend on durable schema relationships, but these references are not enforced in SQLite or the generated migration, so orphaned or cross-entity records can be inserted despite the Drizzle relations API implying integrity.

The package-level schema tests only assert table existence and a couple of successful inserts, so they would not detect missing foreign-key constraints or other relational-integrity regressions in the generated migration. This left the blocking schema issue above unverified even though the feature claims a verified migration foundation.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The repo has no top-level README.md, yet the worker transcript includes an attempted `Read` of `/root/thesislab/README.md` because global exec guidance says to start exploration there. The project guidance should document the actual equivalent entrypoint (for example mission docs plus `.factory/library/*`) to avoid repeated dead-end lookups.

summary: Reviewed handoff, transcript skeleton, backend-worker skill, shared-state docs, and commit `80f7948`. The feature added substantial `packages/db` groundwork, but it should fail scrutiny because multiple schema relations are modeled only at the TypeScript/Drizzle relation layer and are not enforced by foreign keys in the generated SQLite schema, leaving the migration foundation insufficiently durable for downstream repository features.
